enrichDetails.description: Optional. When true, fetches each listing's detail page to add financial fields (Cash Flow, Gross Revenue, EBITDA, Real Estate, Established, Employees, FF&E, Rent). Adds 1 HTTP request per listing — slower but more complete. Off by default.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich with detail-page financials

maxItems.description: Maximum number of business listings to extract.
maxItems.title: Max Items

proxy.description: Optional proxy configuration. The actor uses the unprotected mobile subdomain (m.bizbuysell.com) and works without a proxy from any datacenter IP.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration (optional)

searchUrl.description: BizBuySell URL to scrape. State-level paths (e.g. https://www.bizbuysell.com/california-businesses-for-sale/) and the base /businesses-for-sale/ URL work reliably. Query string filters (?q=, ?pmin=, ?pmax=) and city sub-paths are not honored by the mobile subdomain. URLs are auto-rewritten to m.bizbuysell.com.
searchUrl.title: BizBuySell URL
